init_process_group: init a distributed process group with a given backend and init method for multi-GPU training
get_rank: get the current process rank in the distributed process group or zero if unavailable
all_reduce: all_reduce a tensor across all processes using SUM, PRODUCT, MIN, or MAX operations
all_gather: all_gather tensors from all processes into a list for cross-rank data collection
barrier: barrier all processes in the distributed group to synchronize execution across ranks
